projects.subtitle: A selection of my recent work: business applications, AI automation and e-commerce

1.title: Visualforce AI Documentation Generator
1.description: A powerful Node.js-based tool that automatically generates documentation for Salesforce Visualforce pages in Markdown format. Perfect for Salesforce developers who want to save time maintaining technical documentation.
features: Extraction of Visualforce components (apex:page, apex:form, apex:inputField, apex:commandButton, etc.)
Detection of controllers, extensions, and recordSetVar references
Parsing of Apex classes for methods and properties
Enhanced extraction of components (apex:pageBlock, apex:pageBlockSection, apex:pageBlockSectionItem)
AI-powered summarization of component purposes and functionalities
Markdown generation with structured sections (Overview, Components, Controllers, etc.)
Customizable templates using Handlebars
Command-line interface for easy usage

2.title: Bakery SaaS
2.description: A SaaS platform designed to help bakeries manage inventory, reduce stock loss, and track sales performance in real-time.
features: Real-time inventory management
Online ordering system
Analytics dashboard
Customer management

captions.0: Login page for BakeryOS SaaS with secure authentication
captions.1: Stock Reception Overview showing incoming inventory and alerts
captions.2: Recipe Overview with ingredient management and preparation steps
captions.3: Product Overview dashboard with sales and product metrics
captions.4: POS Overview for seamless checkout and order management
captions.5: Inventory Overview with detailed stock levels and analytics

6.title: Lead Intelligence Platform (SLI)
6.description: A B2B lead generation and qualification platform built at SIMTIS for the export team: it discovers target companies, finds decision-makers, qualifies prospects with AI and follows every opportunity to the sale — with a person always deciding before any contact.
features: Prospect discovery from web search and AI suggestions, with human review
Contact enrichment that prioritises decision-makers
AI qualification: score, buying intent, signals and recommended message
Kanban pipeline, follow-ups, agenda and exportable reports
Separate export and local market views, with roles and permissions
Data quality checks: anomalies, duplicates and normalisation

7.title: Group-wide Claude AI Training
7.description: Designed and led the generative AI training program across the group, from a needs assessment of each department to custom Claude Skills tailored to their work.
features: Needs assessment for each department
Shared sessions for the whole group
Department-specific workshops
Custom Skills created for each department

8.title: E-commerce Redesign, SEO & Custom PrestaShop Modules
8.description: Complete redesign of a multilingual PrestaShop store for a scarf and shawl brand with a network of physical stores: new theme and user experience, 20+ custom modules, automated stock synchronisation, and an SEO strategy that took it from page 10 to page 1 of Google in all three of its languages. I also handle its daily maintenance and security.
features: Complete redesign in French, English and Arabic: theme, pages and user experience
20+ custom modules: upsell pop-ups, cart rewards, tiered discounts, affiliate tracking, live sales notifications, sales by channel
Automated stock sync from the ERP file twice a day, with in-store availability on each product page
Multilingual SEO: from page 10 to page 1 of Google in all 3 languages
Daily maintenance, updates and security monitoring

9.title: M.A.G Store
9.description: My own Shopify store focused on home comfort (cocooning), with delivery across Morocco and cash on delivery. I built the store and created the brand identity.
features: Shopify store built and maintained
Delivery across Morocco
Cash on delivery
Brand identity: logo and positioning

10.title: VR Showroom
10.description: A personal project: an immersive real estate showroom on the web. Visitors explore each property in 3D, walk through it room by room or in 360°, and every visit becomes a qualified lead in a built-in CRM.
features: Project catalogue and pages with renderings and unit types
Interactive floor plan that adapts to the chosen surface
3D model: rotate it, open each room, see its dimensions
Immersive walkthrough and 360° panoramas
Built-in CRM: automatic lead scoring, assignment and pipeline
Analytics: visit journeys, lead funnel, most viewed properties

11.title: Simtis Studio — AI Fashion Visuals
11.description: An in-house AI studio built at SIMTIS that turns a simple photo of a shawl or scarf into professional visuals worn by a model, ready for e-commerce, social media and customer catalogues — in a few clicks instead of a photo shoot.
features: Model renders from a product photo: pose, setting, wearing style and photo style
Two AI engines: lively scenes and posters, or faithful virtual try-on
Shared generation queue with daily and monthly quotas per store
Approval workflow: renders approved or sent back to be redone
Product sheets in 3 languages, exportable as PDF
Photo to video: a render becomes a short animated clip

12.title: Export Showcase Site & B2B Prospecting CRM
12.description: For a heritage scarf and shawl house: a multilingual showcase website for wholesalers and distributors abroad, connected to a B2B CRM that finds, scores and follows international prospects — from first contact to the first order.
features: Showcase site with a catalogue you leaf through like a book and no cart: every page leads to a trade enquiry
Multilingual site with an Arabic right-to-left layout, designed for mobile
Enquiries saved and retried until they reach the CRM, bots filtered out
Prospect search on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook with multilingual rule-based scoring
Human review, duplicate detection, 7-stage pipeline and follow-ups
Roles, territories and a history no one can edit

13.title: WooCommerce → PrestaShop 9 Migration
13.description: Full migration of a fashion e-commerce store from WordPress/WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9: catalogue, content, customers and order history, with a custom theme and modules, a replayable import and every old URL redirected to keep its SEO.
features: Python extractor for the public site (read-only) and the WooCommerce data
Replayable import with dry run: no duplicates, manual edits never overwritten
Customers and full order history migrated, totals checked against the source
Custom theme and modules: editable homepage blocks, blog, one-page checkout
301 redirects for every old URL, generated and checked automatically
Automated browser tests on desktop and mobile, plus deployment guides
